SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_week, fiscal_week_start_date, fiscal_week_end_date
FROM dim_date
WHERE calendar_date IN (SELECT MAX(sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line)
ORDER BY fiscal_week DESC
LIMIT 1

FROM dim_product

calls.statement:
SELECT sku, product_name
FROM dim_product
WHERE product_name LIKE '%Oulu Kaakkuri%' OR product_name LIKE '%Kaakkuri%'
LIMIT 5

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_week,
  d.fiscal_week_start_date,
  d.fiscal_week_end_date,
  p.sku,
  p.product_name,
  SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line AS f
INNER JOIN dim_product AS p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date AS d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE p.sku = 101624
  AND d.fiscal_week = 22
GROUP BY d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date, p.sku, p.product_name

SELECT

  p.product_name,
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_week,
  SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold

INNER JOIN dim_product AS p ON f.product_key = p.product_key

WHERE p.sku = 101624
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_week = 22
GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week
